ablation_scope.compared_component: three arms: deterministic rules; deterministic rules plus optional LLM fallback; and deterministic rules with development-seeded learned-rule memory
ablation_scope.candidate_acceptance: Model candidates remain unaccepted. Executable validity and expected-output matches are separate metrics. human reviewer effort is not collected and is reported as null.
ablation_scope.learned_rule_protocol: The safeguards arm seeds its local learned-rule store from development cases only. The development-seeded store is restored before every held-out case and repeat; held-out cases cannot teach later cases.
shared_mechanisms: Risk-aware finite validation and contract reporting are common to all arms and cannot be disabled safely; their individual effects are not estimated.
limitations: The pilot has only four held-out task groups and remains too small for broad generalization claims.
ablation_scope.live_provider_replayability: Provider-enabled runs can vary across requests. Candidate hashes, provider/model/prompt metadata, request IDs, and case results are recorded; they do not make model generation deterministic.
